User actively discusses and remains bullish on SNDK, repeatedly highlighting Leopold's large position ($5.674B) with 50% FCF margins and 80% gross margins projected into 2030, comparing it favorably to other memory names, noting structural demand and price hikes, with personal portfolio overlap in legacy memory and no signs of exit.
